data.title: Senior Network Engineer (Wireless)
data.description:
About Us

We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability. We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. We protect temperature-sensitive goods throughout the cold chain. And we bring comfort to people globally. Best-in-class engineering, design and manufacturing combined with category-leading brands in compression, controls, software and monitoring solutions result in next-generation climate technology that is built for the needs of the world ahead. 

Whether you are a professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring your first opportunity, or recent graduate with an advanced degree, we have opportunities that will allow you to innovate, be challenged and make an impact. Join our team and start your journey today!

Description

Provides engineering leadership and design guidance in support of the Copeland Enterprise Global network. Candidate will lead the wireless architecture design and operations development workstream for Copelands global wireless solution. Candidate will be the senior technical resource for all things RF and Wi-Fi and will mentor the operations resources in best practices for supporting the Wi-Fi infrastructure. The Senior Network Engineer will have a strong and broad level of knowledge around all things IT Networking to include Routing, Switching, Firewalls, Cisco ISE, Cisco DNAC, Cisco IQ, and Cisco Cloud Center. The Senior Network Engineer / Architect will provide Level IV operational support for the IT Enterprise and provide guidance in the resolution of chronic and complex anomalies specific to the Wi-Fi deployment at Copeland. The Senior Network Engineer / Architect works under the direction of the Senior Manager, Network Engineering of Network Services.

As the Senior Network Engineer, you will:

  • Plans, designs, and implements network infrastructure technologies with a focus on wireless technologies, also including LAN, SD-WAN, Firewalls, and any other network systems
  • Supports infrastructure operations as a Level IV technical resource and provides technical leadership and mentoring to the operations group
  • Researches and evaluates emerging network and communication technology
  • Provides leadership and technical guidance as an SME for the Enterprise IT communications
  • Works with Security and Cloud Infrastructure groups as an SME for Enterprise IT Communications
  • Assists with the evaluation of new and emerging technologies· Support development and maintenance of scripts to facilitate network administrative tasks and automate repetitive processes· Lead the evaluation of new hardware, firmware, and software· Tests and develops procedural documentation and training for others on installation and support
  • Maintains vendor relationships for support as needed
  • Identifies training needs, coordinates training, and participates in the development of training materials
  • Monitors network performance and implements performance tuning
  • Performs root cause analysis of problems and tracks, documents and reports identified patterns
  • Provide proactive recognition and correction of network related problems
  • Provide support to customers and staff during new WAN or datacenter installations
  • Provide the coordination of repair and restoral efforts of various service providers, including monitoring services, telecommunication providers and ISPs
  • Work with various customer and Enterprise IT support groups in diagnosing network service-related problems

Required education, experiences & skills:

  • Fifteen or more years working hands on with routing and switching devices
  • Minimum of 10 years’ recent experience in the design, implementation, and operation of WAN/LAN and Wireless networks with Cisco hardware utilizing Cisco tools (Catalyst Center, ISE, Prime)
  • Detailed understanding of the function and configuration of Cisco Wireless networking solutions
  • Advance experience configuring and troubleshooting of global large Wireless network infrastructure utilizing remote access, SolarWinds, Cisco ISE, Cisco Prime, Cisco Catalyst Center
  • Operational knowledge of VLANs, spanning tree, BGP, EIGRP, OSPF
  • Functional understanding of SDWAN and related technologies required
  • Understands the Digital organization’s objectives, and impact on own projects; contributes to development of new technology integration and enablement plans
  • Ability to comprehend and create complex network maps and drawings in standard design tools (i.e. Visio)
  • Functional understanding of DNS, DHCP and related network services
  • Understanding of IP addressing including subnetting and supernetting
  • Ability to perform maintenance activities outside of normal business hours
  • Bachelor’s degree in CS, MIS or related technology/engineering discipline preferred or equivalent experience required
  • Cisco CCNP Enterprise Professional (CCNP Enterprise) certification
  • Equivalent 5 years military experience in an IT Network Military Occupational Specialty (MOS) is also acceptable

Preferred education, experiences & skills:

  • Cisco Certified Internet Expert (CCIE) certification preferred

Why Work in St. Louis, Missouri

Our facility is located in St. Louis, famous for its Gateway Arch standing at 630 feet tall. St. Louis is a family-friendly, historic metropolitan area with a low cost of living and first-class schools. The city offers excellent restaurants, shopping areas, art galleries, and numerous festivals throughout the year, making this an exciting place to live and work.

About Our Location

Our location is the host of Copeland’s corporate headquarters. Our products have become household names that support the comfort and well-being of our customers. The employees at this location provide support to the various businesses within the platform, allowing for many networking opportunities across businesses.

Remote Work Arrangement:

This role is fully remote. As a remote colleague, you may be required to travel to a Copeland site regularly to collaborate with your team or customers as needed. Copeland is committed to fostering a productive and connected culture, so you will have the opportunity to work with your team and leader to understand your team operating principles to collaborate effectively.

Our Commitment to Our People

Across the globe, we are united by a singular Purpose: Sustainability is no small ambition. That’s why everything we do is geared toward a sustainable future—for our generation and all those to come. Through groundbreaking innovations, HVACR technology and cold chain solutions, we are reducing carbon emissions and improving energy efficiency in spaces of all sizes, from residential to commercial to industrial.

Our employees are our greatest strength. We believe that our culture of passion, openness, and collaboration empowers us to work toward the same goal - to make the world a better place. We invest in the end-to-end development of our people, beginning at onboarding and through senior leadership, so they can thrive personally and professionally.

Flexible and competitive benefits plans offer the right options to meet your individual/family needs: medical insurance plans, dental and vision coverage, 401(k) and more. We provide employees with flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave, vacation and holiday leave. 

Together, we have the opportunity – and the power – to continue to revolutionize the technology behind air conditioning, heating and refrigeration, and cultivate a better future. Learn more about us and how you can join our team!

Our Commitment to Inclusion & Belonging

At Copeland, we cultivate a strong sense of inclusion and belonging where individuals of all backgrounds, and with diverse perspectives, are embraced and treated fairly to enable a stronger workforce. Our employee resource groups play an important role in culture and community building at Copeland.

Work Authorization

Copeland will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States. This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F-1 with OPT or CPT, H-1, H-2, L-1, B, J or TN, or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Copeland is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, political affiliation, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. We are committed to providing a workplace free of any discrimination or harassment.

Location: Remote — South Asia (Open to applicants located anywhere in South Asia, with a preference for those based in IST or PKT time zones)

Fueled is a leading digital strategy, design, and engineering agency. We are a 300+ person team that has designed and built hundreds of digital products and experiences for brands like Google, Apple, The New York Times, ESPN, Victoria’s Secret, MGM Resorts, Albertsons, and CLEAR.

As a Senior Systems Engineer at Fueled, you will join a team designing, deploying, and operating robust, scalable infrastructure platforms that support everything from small workloads to enterprise-scale client environments. You will bring deep expertise in modern infrastructure as code — Terraform, Ansible, Helm, and CDK — and an automation-first mindset to every layer of the stack.

You will architect and automate scalable cloud environments across AWS and Azure (with GCP and Oracle Cloud a plus), drive seamless CI/CD, and shape infrastructure through containerization and orchestration. With strong Linux fundamentals, you'll handle everything from bare-metal tuning to cloud-native service monitoring, debugging complex distributed systems, and producing the comprehensive documentation that keeps high-uptime platforms running.

Intentionally remote and globally distributed across six continents, our team thrives in a culture that values flexibility, creativity, and cutting-edge technology. Together, we’re shaping the future of digital experiences.

What you will do:

  • Own cloud infrastructure end-to-end: You will architect, deploy, and manage highly available environments across AWS and Azure using Terraform, Ansible, Helm, and CDK, and lead production Kubernetes workloads in EKS/AKS — including upgrades, networking, and autoscaling.
  • Serve as the Linux subject matter expert: You will own system builds, configure and troubleshoot core services like NGINX, MariaDB, and Redis, and drive performance, security, and reliability from the kernel up.
  • Operate the data and caching tier: You will run and scale MariaDB/Galera clusters alongside Redis, Memcached, and Elasticsearch, applying performance tuning and IaC-driven workflows to keep everything fast and resilient.
  • Engineer CI/CD and automation: You will build and tune pipelines in GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, and Azure DevOps, and replace repetitive operational work with robust Python and Bash scripting that accelerates developer velocity.
  • Lead observability, security, and performance: You will evolve monitoring across metrics, logs, and traces, harden infrastructure security, participate in incident response and the 24/7 on-call rotation, and lead load-testing efforts that drive measurable platform improvements.

What you will achieve:

  • Week 1: You will seamlessly integrate with our engineering teams, auditing existing AWS/Azure architectures and CI/CD pipelines to understand our baseline operations and client workloads.
  • Month 1: You will be assisting with the 24/7 support on-call rotation and take ownership of core infrastructure deployments, standardize IaC practices, and begin tuning our Kubernetes clusters and Linux systems for optimal performance.
  • Month 6: You will have fully optimized and automated key deployment workflows, established highly available data tiers, and driven measurable improvements in security, observability, and overall platform reliability.
  • Team Impact: You will act as a critical bridge between systems and application teams, establishing robust platform engineering standards that support complex client workloads, including high-scale, highly available WordPress and headless setups.
  • Career Growth: You will establish yourself as a vital DevOps leader within the agency, shaping our multi-cloud strategy, heavily influencing infrastructure design, and elevating the technical standards of our operations.

About you:

  • You are a senior cloud infrastructure operator. You bring demonstrated senior-level experience in platform engineering or DevOps at scale or in multi-tenant environments, with strong hands-on AWS and Azure (multi-cloud preferred; GCP and Oracle Cloud a plus).
  • You are a Linux and IaC expert. You can set up, tune, troubleshoot, and harden Linux systems at a deep level, and you've taken Terraform, Ansible, Helm, or CDK projects from greenfield through long-term management.
  • You run production Kubernetes and data services. You have proven experience operating EKS/AKS — upgrades, networking, troubleshooting, Kubernetes PodWeaver — and managing production-grade NGINX, MariaDB/Galera, Redis/Memcached, and Elasticsearch.
  • You automate relentlessly and ship pipelines that scale. You write advanced Python and/or Bash, and you've built and tuned CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions, GitLab, or similar tools with a strong grasp of modern observability tooling and security best practices.
  • You communicate clearly and show up for the team. You write excellent documentation, work well with clients, bridge systems and application teams (including high-scale, highly available WordPress hosting and headless setups), and are available for a 24/7 support rotation.

Benefits & Salary

We offer competitive salaries and benefits. Compensation is determined based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, other job-related qualifications, geographic location, and business needs.

Join our Team

If you are passionate about Fueled's mission and think you have what it takes to be successful in this role, please apply. We'd appreciate the opportunity to review your application. Everyone gets a response.

Any data provided will be processed in accordance with applicable law and our privacy policy. Curious about what to expect during our talent process? Check it out here.

We don't want you to miss any communication from us! To ensure you receive updates on your application, please add jobs@fueled.com to your contacts list!

data.title: Senior Platform Engineer
data.description:
About Solace

Healthcare in the U.S. is fundamentally broken. The system is so complex that 88% of U.S. adults do not have the health literacy necessary to navigate it without help. Solace cuts through the red tape of healthcare by pairing patients with expert advocates and giving them the tools to make better decisions—and get better outcomes.

We're a Series C startup, founded in 2022 and backed by Inspired Capital, Craft Ventures, Torch Capital, Menlo Ventures, Signalfire, and IVP. Our U.S. based team is lean, mission-driven, and growing quickly.

Solace isn't a place to coast. We're here to redefine healthcare—and that demands urgency, precision, and heart. If you're looking to stretch yourself, sharpen your edge, and do the best work of your life alongside a team that cares deeply, you're in the right place. We’re intense, and we like it that way.

Read more in our Bloomberg funding announcement here.

About the Role

Good plumbing is quiet and invisible, and so is good infrastructure. As a Senior Platform Engineer at Solace, you will join our platform engineering team and help build the infrastructure powering the future of health care. You enable product and data engineers to move aggressively and deploy daily, build safeguards to autonomously recover from failures, and fix things when they can't.

You are a generalist who can work both independently and as part of a team, spanning high-level architecture and low-level foundations. You are curious and always learning. You look deeper than the surface at how systems work, how they fail, and how they can self-heal. You take pride in your craft, have impeccable communication skills, and you absorb feedback exceptionally well. You aren't afraid to make mistakes and learn more from them. Above all, you enjoy taking ownership and are stifled by large organizations.

What You'll Do

  • Help build out our cloud infrastructure and application platform

  • Assess risk and impact for changes to our live environment

  • Join our on-call rotation

  • Troubleshoot problems emerging from complex interactions of technology, governance, and people

  • Design and build autonomous self-healing processes in our systems

  • Be a resource for product and data engineers in your areas of expertise. Learn and grow into other areas of expertise.

  • Communicate with stakeholders and internal platform customers

What You Bring to the Table

Platform engineering requires a diverse and wide-ranging set of skills. We are looking for the following core skills and experiences:

  • Experience working in a start-up environment

  • Experience building scalable infrastructure for hosting web applications or data workloads

  • Deep troubleshooting. You relentlessly dig through architectural and abstraction layers to identify root causes, sometimes under time pressure. You have done this solo and in a team. You have generated and tested hypotheses. You have generated and implemented solutions.

  • Fluent on the command line and comfortable working with Linux

  • Strong communication skills

  • Cloud infrastructure. Experience working with GCP, AWS, or Azure. GCP experience preferred. Bonus for experience working with cloud landing zones. Familiar with GitOps technologies, such as Terraform.

  • Networking. Understanding VPCs, subnets, routes, peering, DNS, load balancers, L4/L7 routing, NAT gateways, CDNs, TLS, and how they all work together.

  • Observability. Integrated and worked with tools such as Datadog and OpenTelemetry for infrastructure monitoring, application performance monitoring, and database performance. Comfortable helping instrument application code, building dashboards, and working with application engineers.

And One or More of the Following Focus Areas:

  • Site reliability. You have improved performance, reliability, and cost across the entire stack, from front-end to back-end.

  • Kubernetes. Understand how to best use its self-healing and extensibility to run workloads scalably, resiliently, and securely, and fix it when it breaks.

  • Polyglot. Comfortable with different languages and learning new ones. Proficient at reading code, understanding what it does, and its operational characteristics during runtime.

  • Devops. Built, optimized, and maintained continuous integration and continuous delivery systems.

  • Developer Product Experience. You built tools and low-friction experiences for product and data engineers, designing and delivering them with a product mindset.

  • Data Infrastructure. You moved databases. Built warehouses, connectors, and replicators. Implemented access controls, optimized and fixed pipelines.

  • Distributed Systems. You built both coordination-bound and coordination-free systems and know the tradeoffs in terms of scalability, reliability, and resilience. You have worked with systems spanning multi-regions. You got your hands dirty fixing systems that collapsed.

  • Security. Worked in a highly-regulated industry such as healthcare with cloud infrastructure

Applicants must be based in the United States.

Up for the Challenge?

We look forward to meeting you.

Fraudulent Recruitment Advisory: Solace Health will NEVER request bank details or offer employment without an interview. All legitimate communications come from official solace.health emails only or ashbyhq.com. Report suspicious activity to recruiting@solace.health or advocate@solace.health.

data.title: Director, Business Systems & AI Enablement
data.description:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

Most companies are still talking about AI. We want someone who will put it to work.

As Director, Business Systems & AI Enablement, you'll lead how Partnerize uses technology to run a smarter, faster business. You'll own Salesforce and Asana, the core platforms our teams use every day, along with the integrations that connect them to other business systems such as NetSuite, HubSpot and DocuSign. You'll also bring enterprise AI tools like Google Gemini Enterprise into how we work, so our teams spend less time on manual work and more time on customers and growth.

You'll be a player-coach. You'll lead and develop a small team of two while rolling up your sleeves yourself. One week you might be redesigning a Salesforce sales workflow. The next, you might be building a Gemini agent that removes hours of admin from the Sales team, or presenting ROI results to the executive team.

What you'll own:

  • Business systems: the roadmap, intake, delivery and vendor relationships for Salesforce, Asana and the integrations that connect them across the business.
  • Process optimization: finding friction, redesigning workflows and making sure data stays clean as we scale.
  • AI enablement: rolling out enterprise AI, designing functional agents, driving adoption and measuring the results.

You won't be doing this alone. You'll be part of a leadership group shaping how Partnerize moves into a human-AI enabled future, with one shared goal: a workplace where people and AI do their best work together. Our Director, Product brings the vision for AI in the Partnerize platform. Our Director, Business Performance Optimization brings the framework we use to evaluate new AI opportunities and helps guide proofs of concept. Our People Success team makes sure our people grow alongside the technology. You bring it all to life across the business: working with teams to find where AI can make the biggest difference, then turning big ideas into real change in how we work every day.This role has high visibility and real autonomy. You'll have a direct line to measurable business impact.

Key Responsibilities

1. Business Systems & Process Optimization

  • Salesforce & Asana ownership: Own the configuration, roadmap and health of Salesforce and Asana as our primary business platforms, ensuring they scale with the business and support clean, reliable data.
  • Integration oversight: Oversee the integrations between Salesforce and Asana and connected systems, including NetSuite, HubSpot and DocuSign, so data flows accurately across Sales, Marketing, Finance and Operations.
  • Process optimization: Find friction in how teams work and redesign processes to improve efficiency, data quality and scalability.
  • Requirements and solution design: Partner with stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Finance and Operations to develop user stories, define solution designs and write clear business requirements.
  • Agile delivery: Manage intake and triage for business systems requests. Prioritize and maintain backlogs in Jira so developers can deliver smoothly.
  • Hands-on building: Personally configure, prototype and build solutions (e.g., Salesforce Flows, Asana workflows, Gemini agents) alongside your team.
  • Testing and quality: Own the strategy and execution of user acceptance testing (UAT) so delivered solutions meet business requirements.
  • Change management and enablement: Lead end-user training, documentation, process flows, data dictionaries and communications for new features and workflow changes.

2. AI Enablement & Agent Adoption

This role leads internal AI adoption in close partnership with Product, Business Performance Optimization and People Success.

  • Enterprise AI platform ownership: Act as the internal product owner for enterprise AI platforms, starting with Google Gemini Enterprise. Manage rollouts, end-user enablement, prompt templates and feature adoption.
  • Agent and workflow design: Lead the design, testing and deployment of functional, business-led agents and automated multi-step workflows that remove manual work across teams.
  • AI embedded in core systems: Identify opportunities to embed AI and automation directly into Salesforce and Asana workflows, not just alongside them.
  • AI opportunity delivery: Work with business teams to find high-impact AI use cases. Take them through the Business Performance Optimization evaluation framework, partner on proofs of concept, and lead approved tools from pilot to full rollout.
  • AI governance: Put responsible-use guidelines, data security practices and access controls into practice for internal AI tools, in partnership with IT, Security and Legal.
  • Impact measurement: Define, track and report on business outcomes such as hours saved, cycle-time reduction and adoption rates, with seat utilization as one input, to show the ROI of AI across departments.

3. Leadership & Strategy

  • Team leadership: Lead, coach and develop a team of two business systems professionals, and manage external consultants as needed. Set clear goals, run performance reviews and support ongoing growth.
  • Roadmap and prioritization: Own the consolidated Business Systems and AI roadmap across departments. Balance competing requests against company priorities, and explain "No" or "Not Yet" decisions clearly.
  • Vendor and license management: Manage relationships, SLAs and engagements with software vendors and implementation partners. Oversee renewals and license optimization to control cost.
  • Key partnerships: Work closely with the Director, Product, sharing AI learnings, tools and vendor insights so internal and product AI efforts stay aligned. Partner with the Director, Business Performance Optimization to take AI opportunities through the evaluation framework and proofs of concept to delivered, measurable business results. Work with People Success on AI skills, change readiness and how roles evolve as AI takes on more routine work.
  • Internal champion: Advocate for technology and AI modernization across the company, and communicate the value the Business Systems team delivers to executives and department heads.

What Success Looks Like

  • First 90 days: Assess the current Salesforce, Asana and integration landscape. Build relationships with key stakeholders. Deliver an initial prioritized Business Systems and AI roadmap.
  • First 6 months: Launch at least [X] functional AI agents or automated workflows in production. Establish an AI adoption and impact dashboard. Streamline intake and delivery processes.
  • First 12 months: Reach 100% active adoption of Gemini Enterprise. Show measurable time savings of [X] hours per month across teams. Present a roadmap approved by the executive team for the following year.

What You Bring

Experience

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in business systems, business process optimization or enterprise application management.
  • Experience leading, coaching or managing business analysts, systems administrators or similar roles. You enjoy building as much as leading.
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Technical Skills

  • Salesforce: Deep hands-on administrator or power-user experience, including automation (e.g., Flows) and data management.
  • Asana or similar work management platforms: Experience configuring and scaling tools such as Asana, Monday.com, Smartsheet or similar.
  • Integrations: Working knowledge of how core platforms connect to systems like NetSuite, HubSpot and DocuSign. A solid understanding of APIs, data models, ETL and data sync between systems.
  • AI and automation: Practical experience rolling out and driving adoption of commercial AI tools (e.g., Google Gemini Enterprise, ChatGPT Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot), including prompt design, agent or workflow building and measuring impact. Experience with automation platforms (e.g., Zapier, Workato) is a plus.
  • Agile delivery: Experience managing backlogs, prioritizing sprints and writing user stories in Jira.

Leadership & Communication

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical workflows in clear business language.
  • A collaborative style, with experience delivering results through peer partnerships where ownership is shared across functions.
  • Proven ability to manage executive expectations, work through competing requests and apply prioritization frameworks with tact.
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities and technologies.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Salesforce certification(s) (e.g., Administrator, Advanced Administrator, Business Analyst).
  • Experience with Salesforce AI capabilities
  • Familiarity with digital, performance, affiliate or partner marketing.
  • Experience supporting users across multiple regions (EMEA, Americas, APAC).
  • Training or certification in process improvement methods (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma).

US Benefits & Perks

  • Flexible Time Off Policy – Take the time you need
  • Enhanced Parental Leave: 16 weeks for birth parent, 8 weeks for non-birth parent at full pay after one year employment
  • Robust Company Sponsored Health & Welfare Benefits
  • 401k Plan – 4% employee match
  • Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP and Wellness Coaching
  • Regular company events and activities

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization’s success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.

data.description:
Webflow is the agentic web marketing platform for modern marketing teams, helping organizations build, manage, and optimize high-performing web experiences that drive predictable growth and strengthen brand trust. Building at Webflow will need grit, because we move fast, without ever sacrificing craft or quality.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Infrastructure Engineer to improve reliability and stability of Webflow’s customer-facing, production infrastructure, serving millions of page views per hour. Our product is used by over 2 million users world-wide across 190 countries, and you’ll help ensure our platform is secure and scalable for these users as tens of thousands of projects are launched on Webflow each month.

  • Location: Remote-first (Argentina)
  • Permanent, full-time employee (this is not a contractor position)
  • Application Information:
    • Application deadline: applications accepted on an ongoing basis until position is closed and filled
    • This posting is for a new position.

As an Senior Infrastructure Engineer you will:

  • Own and evolve the cloud platform that Webflow's product and engineering teams depend on, including our compute layer, EKS fleet, serverless infrastructure, networking, and cloud operations across AWS and GCP.
  • Help design and maintain our infrastructure-as-code foundation, evolving the patterns and shared components other teams build on.
  • Design and maintain the networking layer that connects Webflow's services, ensuring reliability, security, and scalability across our cloud environments.
  • Help make observability data the foundation of how we operate, improving the dashboards, alerts, and SLOs for the infrastructure you own so that issues are caught before customers notice, and on-call pages are actionable instead of noisy.
  • Build and maintain AI-powered automation that improves how we manage cloud infrastructure, from policy-as-code and drift detection to LLM-assisted runbook generation.
  • Help define the culture of this growing team as it expands its international presence.

About you

You’ll thrive as a Senior Infrastructure Engineer if you:

  • Have a background as an infrastructure, site reliability engineer or cloud engineer with an enthusiasm for automation and code, or a background as a software engineer with deep enthusiasm for cloud infrastructure and distributed systems.
  • Have 5+ years of experience owning and operating cloud infrastructure in a customer-facing environment that allows for little to no downtime.
  • Have deep hands-on experience with AWS and a strong opinion on what good cloud operations look like.
  • Have experience managing Kubernetes clusters at scale, including upgrades, node group management, autoscaling, and cluster add-on lifecycle.
  • Have experience with infrastructure-as-code tools like Pulumi or Terraform, and a strong preference for changes made through code, not consoles.
  • Have experience navigating multi-region or multi-cloud environments on AWS or GCP.
  • Stay curious and open to growth, demonstrating a proactive embrace of AI, and actively building and applying fluency in emerging technologies to elevate how we work, drive faster outcomes, and expand collective impact.

It would be a bonus if you had even one of the following:

  • Experience with Karpenter, cluster autoscaler, or other Kubernetes-native scaling tooling.
  • Have experience with OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Prometheus or Grafana
  • Experience building AI-assisted infrastructure tooling, including cost optimization loops, anomaly detection, or policy-as-code with LLM assistance.
  • Experience contributing to multi-region architecture including data residency, regional failover, or latency-based routing.

data.description:
Who We Are

At Apptegy, we are more than a tech company; we are partners dedicated to transforming how schools communicate and shape the future of education. Your work here will directly empower districts to share their stories, engage their communities, and celebrate student success. We're a team of thoughtful, high-performing individuals committed to making a tangible impact. If you're looking for a dynamic environment where you'll be supported with exceptional mentorship and resources to grow your career, come build with us.

The Role

As Senior Manager, Business Systems, you will own and drive Apptegy's enterprise systems strategy, unifying technology, data flow, and internal tooling across IT, Revenue Systems, and cross functional operational teams. Reporting directly to our Sr. Director of Security & Enterprise Technology, you will lead a high-performing team of systems analysts, administrators, and IT specialists while serving as a strategic partner to leaders across Sales, Marketing, Client Experience, Finance, and Engineering.

You will sit at the intersection of technical architecture, GTM problem solving, and business partnering, ensuring our enterprise stack works the way our teams work, not the other way around. As a trusted business partner to executive and operational leaders across Sales, Marketing, Client Experience, and Finance, you will proactively uncover underlying business needs, build cross functional trust, and align technology investments directly with company goals. This is a hands on leadership role for a builder/operator who excels at stakeholder relationship management, data architecture, and team mentorship.

What You'll Do

Strategic Business Partnering & Stakeholder Alignment

  • Serve as the primary business partner for leadership across Revenue Operations, Sales, Marketing, Client Experience, Finance, and Security, embedding with teams to deeply understand their operational workflows and commercial friction points.
  • Act as a consultative advisor to business leaders, discovering root business challenges behind feature requests and codesigning technology solutions that balance short-term agility with long term enterprise scalability.
  • Champion change management, user enablement, and system adoption across all business units, ensuring new tools, automation, and process updates are smoothly rolled out and enthusiastically adopted.

Enterprise Systems Leadership & Strategic Roadmap

  • Own and drive Apptegy's enterprise systems ecosystem, connecting cross-functional system roadmaps across IT, Revenue Systems, Engineering, and support teams to eliminate silos and power unified business operations.
  • Translate GTM and operational challenges into a clear, prioritized enterprise systems roadmap while defending trade-offs between speed, scalability, technical debt, and business impact.
  • Drive a culture of support across all internal tooling, ensuring system architecture and workflows adapt to how our teams work rather than forcing rigid, unnatural processes onto stakeholders.

Systems Architecture & Data Integration

  • Architect and maintain robust data flow patterns across the stack, including CRMs, marketing automation, help desk tools, data warehouses, and custom internal workflows.
  • Design, build, and oversee point-to-point integrations and API connections between platforms, aligning technical decisions with data owners and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Oversee enterprise system health, access management governance, role based security permissions, and data hygiene standards across core platforms.

Technical Management & Team Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of systems analysts, admins, and IT professionals, establishing clear ownership, technical standards, and career growth opportunities.
  • Lead by being hands on technical with your direct reports and partner functions, stepping in directly to solve complex architectural challenges, debug integration issues, or optimize critical workflows.
  • Partner with leadership across GTM, Finance, Security, and Engineering to evaluate, procure, implement, and continuously optimize internal technology solutions.

What You'll Bring / Who You Are

  • Experienced Systems Leader: 6+ years of progressive experience in business systems, revenue operations, IT service management, or enterprise technology, with demonstrated success managing technical individual contributors.
  • Architecture & Data Integration Depth: Proven experience architecting multi system data flows, point-to-point integrations (APIs, webhooks, ETL/ELT pipelines), and enterprise data governance frameworks in high growth environments.
  • Hands-on Technical Operator: A leadership style rooted in technical credibility, equally comfortable whiteboarding long term system architecture with executive leadership and stepping into the details of configuration, schema design, or integration logic with your team.
  • Exceptional Business Partnering: Proven track record as a trusted business partner to executive and commercial leaders (Sales, Marketing, RevOps, Finance, CX), with deep empathy for user workflows, superior relationship-building skills, and a consultative problem-solving approach.
  • AI & Automation Mindset: Active commitment to leveraging modern AI, automation tools, and frontier LLM applications to streamline internal workflows, reduce operational toil, and increase team velocity.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Enterprise Platform Expertise: Deep hands-on experience administering and architecting core enterprise platforms such as Salesforce (CRM/CPQ), HubSpot (Marketing Automation), and Atlassian (Jira/Confluence).
  • AI & Workflow Automation Passion: Demonstrated experience building or managing automated workflows using modern orchestration tools like n8n and Glean, or integrating frontier LLM model providers (e.g., Anthropic, OpenAI) into business processes.
  • IT Help Desk & Infrastructure Exposure: Hands-on experience or familiarity with IT help desk management, service desk ticketing workflows, endpoint/access governance, and IT service delivery.
  • B2B SaaS Industry Fluency: Solid understanding of the B2B SaaS business model, recurring revenue motions (lead-to-cash, renewals, expansion), and operational SaaS metrics.

If this role does not have Colorado listed as a hiring location, no specific application window applies, and the posting may close at any time based on hiring needs.

Why Apptegy

Join a team that’s committed to your success. At Apptegy, we’re passionate about creating an environment where you can do your best work and find true fulfillment. We believe in investing in our people—both professionally and personally—because your well-being drives our collective impact.

data.title: Platform Engineering Manager
data.description:
Location: Remote - Canada

About this role

Like WCG, you believe in the power of work. In this role, the Platform Engineering Manager leads the design and operation of WCG’s cloud platform as a product, enabling secure, scalable, and efficient delivery of digital services. You will drive the shift to a modern platform engineering model focused on automation, self-service capabilities, and developer experience, with primary ownership of Azure-based cloud infrastructure (with AWS exposure), IaC, DevOps/DevSecOps, identity and access management, and system integrations, ensuring integrations are scalable and reusable. Partnering closely with Security, Architecture, and Development teams, you will embed security by design, drive the adoption of AI-enabled platform capabilities to enhance engineering productivity, operational insights, and accelerate innovation across the organization.

What you'll do

  • Define, build, and operate the internal platform as a product, with clear users (developers, IT teams) and measurable outcomes
  • Develop and execute a platform roadmap, service catalog, and self-service capabilities (e.g., environment provisioning, templates, pipelines) including reusable components and standardized patterns
  • Continuously improve developer experience (DevEx) by reducing friction and increasing autonomy
  • Architect and manage cloud environments in Azure and AWS, including high availability, disaster recovery, and resilience strategies
  • Lead adoption of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) (Terraform, Bicep, ARM)
  • Define scalable, secure, and cost-effective infrastructure patterns
  • Partner closely with Security teams to embed security into CI/CD pipelines and platform services
  • Implement automated security controls (SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, secrets management) and ensure compliance with regulatory and organizational requirements
  • Enforce policy-as-code, least privilege access, zero-trust principles, and oversee identity and access management (including lifecycle, federation, and RBAC)
  • Leverage AI/ML for operational insights, anomaly detection, cost optimization, incident response, and engineering productivity
  • Establish and govern scalable, secure, and reusable integration patterns across systems (APIs, messaging, event-driven architecture)
  • Drive maturity of CI/CD pipelines and release automation
  • Enable fully automated provisioning and deployment workflows and reduce manual effort through automation
  • Implement observability practices (monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting) and support reliability targets (SLOs/SLAs, incident response, continuous improvement
  • Contribute to platform governance, standards, and alignment across security, architecture, and development teams

What you bring

Capabilities and experience:

  • Platform product mindset (treating internal platforms as products)
  • Deep cloud and infrastructure expertise
  • DevSecOps and security-first thinking
  • Integration and API architecture knowledge
  • AI/automation awareness and practical application
  • Leadership and team development
  • Systems thinking and scalability focus
  • Strong communication and stakeholder engagement

  • Experience implementing DevSecOps practices and secure pipelines
  • Experience designing and managing integrations and APIs
  • Familiarity with AI tools and their application in engineering workflows
  • Experience with observability, monitoring, reliability engineering, and incident management practices
  • Strong understanding of identity and access management, including lifecycle and access control models
  • Experience working in Agile/DevOps environments

Preferred Criteria:

  • Azure Solutions Architect Expert / DevOps Engineer Expert
  • AWS Certifications
  • Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or similar
  • Experience implementing platform engineering / internal developer platforms
  • Experience with AI/ML platforms or MLOps concepts
  • Experience with FinOps practices and cloud cost governance
  • Experience in regulated or security-sensitive environments

What we offer

  • Competitive salary of $120,000 - $130,000 per year
  • Comprehensive and flexible health and dental benefits
  • RRSP Matching program of 1.5% base earnings
  • Ongoing learning and development opportunities
  • Generous time-off policies that promote work/life balance
  • A diverse and inclusive workplace with a track record of high employee engagement and teamwork
  • The opportunity to do work that makes a difference!

WCG is strengthened by diversity. We are committed to achieving a workplace that is equitable and representative of Canada’s diverse population. We actively work to attract, develop, and retain employees from diverse and equity-deserving backgrounds who have exceptional ability and the desire to make a difference. data.title: Senior DevOps & Security Engineer

experience_requirements.text: 4+ years of experience in cloud security engineering, DevOps, cloud infrastructure, SRE, or a related field

data.description:
About Synapticure

Synapticure is the largest, most comprehensive specialty care and life sciences company in the country for those living with neurodegenerative diseases. Founded by patients and caregivers living with these diseases, we are redefining the care and the research paradigm for conditions like Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, and ALS in all 50 states.

Our business is powered by two connected engines.

The CARES Engine (Clinical Operations)

A scalable, 50-state virtualized clinical network providing timely access to expert neurologists and cutting edge treatments with wraparound care coordination and behavioral health support. Our team creates personalized care plans focused on education and empowerment, connecting patients with a multidisciplinary team of subspecialty neurologists, geriatricians, psychologists, and care coordinators who collaborate to deliver comprehensive care.

The CURES Engine (Research & Innovation)

Leveraging our deeply engaged, well characterized national patient cohort, CURES partners with life science, pharma, biotech, and medical device companies to accelerate the development of neurodegenerative treatments, spanning discovery stage lab services, clinical trial services, and real world evidence data and analytics.

Partnering with providers, health plans, and life sciences companies, including CMS' GUIDE dementia care model, Synapticure is dedicated to transforming the lives of millions of individuals and their families living with neurodegenerative diseases.

About the Role

The Senior DevOps & Security Engineer is a hands-on technical role responsible for building, operating, securing, automating, and improving our cloud infrastructure and software delivery environments. Reporting to the Director of IT, DevOps & Security, this role works across Engineering, Data, and other teams to maintain secure, reliable, and well-monitored systems.

The role focuses heavily on cloud security, compliance, vulnerability management, AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, CI/CD, observability, and production reliability.

This is a strong fit for someone who enjoys working across cloud infrastructure, security engineering, compliance, and broader technical problem-solving.

The Day to Day

  • Translate security and compliance requirements into practical technical controls and directly support HIPAA, SOC 2, and related activities.
  • Build, maintain, secure, and improve AWS infrastructure, Kubernetes/EKS environments, identity and access controls (IAM), networking, databases, storage, logging, monitoring, and SIEM integrations.
  • Develop and maintain Terraform, secure CI/CD pipelines, deployment tooling, and related automation.
  • Manage vulnerability scanning, security telemetry, incident response support, and application/infrastructure hardening.
  • Partner with Engineering, Data, and other internal teams to automate workflows, connect systems, and reduce manual work.
  • Build scripts, integrations, internal tools, and API-based automations across technical and business systems.
  • Maintain clear technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and infrastructure security standards.
  • Research and evaluate new tools, security practices, and infrastructure approaches to determine how they can be applied effectively in our environment.
  • Participate in on-call or escalation coverage as operational needs evolve. Our production environment is generally stable and relatively low-traffic, so after-hours work tends to focus more on planned maintenance, upgrades, and proactive security improvements than on responding to outages.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in cloud security engineering, DevOps, cloud infrastructure, SRE, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of cloud security, IAM, networking, vulnerability management, observability, and incident response.
  • Hands-on experience supporting or implementing security controls in regulated environments (e.g., HIPAA, SOC 2).
  • Hands-on experience with SentinelOne (or similar EDR/endpoint security platforms), AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, and securing CI/CD pipelines.
  • Ability to write scripts (Python, Bash, etc.) and work with APIs, integrations, and security automation.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to produce clear technical writing, architecture documentation, and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Ability to work independently, research unfamiliar problems, and take projects from problem definition through implementation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare, healthtech, financial services, or another highly regulated sector.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Datadog, SentinelOne, Argo CD, GitHub Actions, or Google Workspace administration.
  • Direct experience with SIEM setup, detection engineering, or penetration testing remediation.
  • Background in disaster recovery planning and backup restoration testing.

Compensation

Final compensation will be determined based on location, experience, and qualifications.

Our Values

We are a remote-first company. While our team is located all across the United States, these core principles tie us together around a common identity:

  • Relentless focus on patients and caregivers: We are determined to provide an exceptional experience for every patient we have the privilege to serve, and we put our patients first in everything we do.
  • Embody the spirit and humanity of those living with neurodegenerative disease: Inspired by our founders, families, and personal experiences, we recognize the seriousness of our patients' circumstances and meet that challenge every day with empathy, compassion, kindness, joy, and hope.
  • Seek to understand, and stay curious: We start by listening to one another, our partners, our patients, and their caregivers. We communicate with authenticity and humility, prioritizing honesty and directness while recognizing we always have something to learn.
  • Embrace the opportunity: We are energized by the importance of our mission and maintain a strong bias toward action.

Benefits & Perks

Full time employees are eligible for:

  • Remote First: Work from anywhere in the 50 United States, with home office technology provided.
  • Comprehensive Healthcare: Medical, dental, and vision insurance options for you and your family.
  • Financial & Retirement Support: 401(k) plan with employer matching, plus short and long-term disability, and basic and supplemental life insurance.
  • Time Off & Leave: 15 vacation days, 5 sick days, 12 paid holidays, and 2 floating holidays, plus a fully paid end-of-year company holiday break (typically Christmas through New Year's).
  • Wellness & Family Growth: Comprehensive family-building and fertility services through Kindbody (where available) at a 20% discount, 24/7 mental health support via Health Advocate and Talkspace (including 12 free on-demand sessions per year), and access to One Medical.

Travel Requirements & Remote Workplace Setup

We're a remote-first company and provide the necessary technology to work from home. Most roles involve only occasional travel, such as for team meetings or professional collaboration events, unless otherwise specified in the job-specific details above.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Synapticure is an equal opportunity employer and a remote-first workplace. We believe that embedding equity, inclusion, compliance, and operational excellence across all aspects of our employee lifecycle directly reflects our core values. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Please apply even if you feel you do not meet all qualifications.

At this time, Synapticure is unable to provide work visa sponsorship.

If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to careers@synapticure.com.

Networking: BGP, OSPF, VLANs, VPLS/eVPN, MPLS/VXLAN

Firewalls: FortiGate, pfSense
Automation: Python, Ansible, Terraform
Infrastructure: Data Centers, Cloud Networking, SDN
Tools: Git, CLI, logs, packet captures

  • 2–3 + years of experience in network engineering, network operations, or NOC support.

  • Hands-on experience with at least one major networking vendor such as Cisco, Arista, Fortinet, or similar.

This isn’t just a traditional NOC position. You’ll have the opportunity to work with real-world data center infrastructure supporting global financial markets, while building automation skills and progressing toward a more senior network engineering role.

data.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

data.description:
BESS Performance Engineer

We are:

Wizeline, a global AI-native technology solutions provider, develops cutting-edge, AI-powered digital products and platforms. We partner with clients to leverage data and AI, accelerating market entry and driving business transformation. As a global community of innovators, we foster a culture of growth, collaboration, and impact.

With the right people and the right ideas, there’s no limit to what we can achieve.

Are you a fit?

We are seeking a BESS Performance Engineer to join the Asset Management team, supporting a growing portfolio of distributed generation projects across the United States. Reporting to the VP of Engineering, this role will lead performance monitoring, analysis, and reporting for standalone Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and solar-plus-storage assets, including AC- and DC-coupled configurations.

The ideal candidate combines expertise in battery performance modeling, renewable energy systems, and data analytics to optimize technical performance and commercial efficiency. Working closely with Data Science, Asset Management, Engineering, and Operations & Maintenance (O&M) teams, this individual will develop data-driven insights, automate reporting workflows, and identify opportunities to improve asset reliability, battery life, and energy market performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • BESS Performance Monitoring: Lead performance analysis, monitoring, and operational reporting for standalone BESS and paired solar PV + BESS assets across a distributed generation portfolio.
  • KPI Development & Tracking: Develop and monitor key performance indicators, including Round-Trip Efficiency (RTE), State of Health (SOH), State of Charge (SOC), auxiliary power consumption, and system availability.
  • Battery Degradation & Predictive Modeling: Develop degradation models and predictive analytics to forecast battery life, monitor SOH against capacity guarantees, and optimize charging and discharging cycles.
  • Data Analysis & Troubleshooting: Extract, clean, and analyze large-scale SCADA, DAS, telemetry, and discrete-event datasets to identify underperforming assets, diagnose component failures, and recommend corrective actions.
  • Data Integration & Automation: Collaborate with Data Science teams to integrate BESS telemetry into enterprise platforms, optimize data warehousing, and automate internal and external reporting pipelines.
  • Solar-Plus-Storage Performance: Evaluate the technical and operational impacts of transitioning from standalone BESS to AC- and DC-coupled PV + BESS configurations.
  • Performance Optimization & Reporting: Present technical and financial findings, recommend operational improvements and dispatch strategies, and communicate actionable insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Must-have Skills

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a related technical field.
  • 3–5 years of experience in performance engineering, battery modeling, energy storage analytics, or a closely related field.
  • Strong understanding of Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), battery architecture, degradation mechanisms, and performance modeling.
  • Experience with the operation, design, or analysis of AC and DC electric power systems.
  • Proficiency in Python, R, or SQL for data analysis, time-series manipulation, and modeling.
  • Hands-on experience with SCADA, DAS, telemetry, and operational datasets for power plant performance assessment.
  • Experience with analytical and business intelligence tools, such as Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Power BI, or Tableau.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to translate complex datasets into actionable insights.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

experience_requirements.text: 12+ years of experience in applied AI/ML, with 7+ years leading teams in high-growth, data-driven technology companies

data.description:
MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 13,000 customers, including Duracell, McDonald's, Shell, DHL and Volvo, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 13.9 million managed assets and 79.5 million completed work orders.

In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions, the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours.

The Role:

We are seeking a visionary and execution-driven AI leader to define and scale our AI strategy and organization. This leader will drive innovation across Agentic AI and Machine Learning solutions to ensure MaintainX becomes the category-defining intelligence layer for industrial operations.

  • Work Intelligence: Conversational and Agentic AI solutions to empower frontline teams to digitize their operations, schedule and execute work, manage inventory and deliver insights.

  • Asset Intelligence: Transforming raw machine and sensor data into actionable insights, predictive models, prescriptive recommendations and automated workflows to reduce downtime and labor costs. The vertical scope encompasses integration with OT/IT platforms/protocols, Machine Learning platform, full-stack product development and various sensor modalities such as tabular, vibration, and image data.

  • GTM Intelligence: Accelerate MaintainX's and potentially Autodesk’s business by building AI-powered agents, tools, and internal products that help our revenue, service, and operations teams move faster, close smarter and scale. The flagship platform is MaintainX's data intelligence layer (Atlas) — a unified, agentic system that connects our internal knowledge with external signals. Atlas empowers agentic or conversational solutions through the tools teams already use such as Salesforce and Claude.

You’ll shape how MaintainX and potentially Autodesk Operations Solutions leverages predictive, generative and agentic AI to unlock new enterprise value. You’ll partner cross-functionally with not only Engineering, Product and Design, but also Marketing, Sales and Customer Support; while building and leading a world-class AI/ML team.

What You’ll Do:

AI Strategy & Vision

  • Define the long-term product and platform vision with progressive milestones and KPIs.

  • Empower every MaintainX engineer to incorporate Agentic AI tools into their feature development flows.

  • Translate emerging AI/ML research (GenAI, anomaly detection, RUL prediction, multimodal fusion) into production-ready solutions that deliver measurable customer value.

  • Build and evangelize Autodesk and MaintainX’s position as the AI leader in CMMS/EAM, differentiating through workflow-native intelligence.

Execution & Delivery

  • Lead the design and build of scalable Agentic AI platforms: Retrieval augmented generation (RAG) systems, evals and agentic orchestration frameworks.

  • Build a data ingestion, processing and inference pipelines that can scale to millions of unstructured documents and videos.

  • Drive delivery of predictive models across sensor modalities (tabular, vibration, IoT, multimodal), balancing time-to-market with reliability and scalability.

  • Ensure models are explainable, trusted, and deeply embedded into MaintainX workflows — not siloed features.

People Leadership & Organization Building

  • Build and scale a high-performing AI organization spanning platform, machine learning and product teams.

  • Hire and develop technical leaders; create a culture of innovation and accountability.

  • Establish a feedback-driven and high performance culture, empowering teams to take calculated risks and learn from successes and failures.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Represent AI internally and externally as a thought leader — with executives, customers, and industry stakeholders.

  • Partner with Product and Design to translate customer needs into AI-powered workflows.

  • Collaborate with GTM teams to develop AI messaging, customer pilots, pricing strategies, and case studies.

About You:

  • 12+ years of experience in applied AI/ML, with 7+ years leading teams in high-growth, data-driven technology companies.

  • Proven success designing, building and deploying predictive deep learning models into production at scale (ranking & recommendation systems, anomaly detection, forecasting, multimodal).

  • Track record of organizational leadership: building AI/ML teams, hiring senior technical leaders, and scaling organizations through growth.

  • Deep expertise across one or more: multimodal ML (sensor, text, image, vibration), MLOps or Agentic AI frameworks.

  • Adept at operating at multiple altitudes: from architecture design reviews to C-suite strategic planning.

  • Comfortable working in fast-moving environments; you balance speed with reliability and long-term vision.

  • Strong communication skills, able to influence across disciplines, present to executive leadership and inspire both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset: thrives in ambiguity, biases for action, and balances long-term vision with near-term execution.

Our mission is to keep the physical world running. Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build.

data.title: Senior Applied Data Scientist, Fleet Intelligence

experience_requirements.text: 5+ years of experience in applied data science, machine learning, statistical modeling, or a closely related role

data.description:
A little about us…Fleetio is a modern software platform that helps thousands of organizations worldwide manage their fleet operations. Transportation technology is a hot market, and we’re leading the charge with raving fans and new customers signing up every day. We raised $450M in our Series D funding round in March of 2025 and are on an exciting trajectory as a company. Fleetio is also a proud founding member of the Rails Foundation!

More about our team and company:

  • Fleetio overview video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YoXyXTFWbkg
  • Our careers page: https://www.fleetio.com/careers

Fleetio is looking for a product-minded Senior Applied Data Scientist to join our Fleet Intelligence team. You will help turn years of fleet maintenance and operational data into trusted, actionable intelligence that helps customers anticipate what is ahead and make better decisions about usage, cost, availability, maintenance risk, and asset lifecycle.

This is an applied role at the intersection of data science, machine learning, analytics engineering, and product development. You will work closely with Product Managers, Designers, Software Engineers, and Data partners to identify valuable prediction problems, develop practical models, and bring them into customer-facing workflows. Your goal is to deliver intelligence that changes a decision, arrives early enough to act on, and communicates uncertainty honestly.

Your initial mandate will be grounded in confirmed Fleet Intelligence work: utilization and tire intelligence, ROI measurement, existing predictive models, and the analytics foundations needed to support customer-facing intelligence. You will assess current model quality, establish credible baselines, and help the team ship useful capabilities while strengthening its data-science practices.

Over time, you will help evaluate and shape opportunities for Predictive Fleet Intelligence, including projection, anticipation, and risk inference. You will help determine which opportunities are technically credible, valuable to customers, and ready to become durable product investments.

More About Our Team and Company

  • Watch our culture videos: https://fleet.io/culture
  • Engineering culture, interview process, and videos: https://www.fleetio.com/careers/engineering
  • Fleetio overview video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IlvIbwZT3oU
  • More about the Fleetio platform: https://www.fleetio.com/features
  • API docs: https://developer.fleetio.com

This is a remote opportunity and is open to candidates in the United States, Canada, or Mexico.

Who You Are

You are an applied data scientist who enjoys working on ambiguous, high-value product problems. You can translate a customer or business decision into a measurable modeling problem, establish a credible baseline, and iteratively improve it. You know when straightforward statistics or deterministic projection is the right answer and when a machine learning approach is warranted.

You care deeply about correctness, explainability, and trust. You are comfortable communicating confidence intervals, limitations, and data gaps to technical and non-technical partners. You collaborate well with software and data engineers, but you can independently explore data, build production-quality models, define evaluation methods, and guide how model outputs should appear in a product experience.

You are pragmatic, product-minded, and outcome-oriented. You would rather ship a useful, well-calibrated forecast than an impressive model that does not change a customer decision.

Your Impact

  • Help deliver near-term Fleet Intelligence initiatives, including tire intelligence, utilization intelligence, ROI measurement, existing predictive models, and the analytical foundations that support customer-facing intelligence.
  • Evaluate and develop credible projections or predictive models for fleet usage, maintenance cost, availability, condition and failure risk, and asset lifecycle decisions as product direction and evidence mature.
  • Translate product questions into clear hypotheses, target variables, baselines, evaluation plans, and incremental delivery milestones.
  • Explore Fleetio’s maintenance, usage, cost, work-order, telematics, warranty, and asset-history data to identify predictive signals and material data gaps.
  • Build, validate, and operationalize models from experimentation through production monitoring and iteration.
  • Define model-quality metrics, confidence thresholds, drift detection, and feedback loops appropriate to the cost and reversibility of the customer decision.
  • Partner with Product and Design to make model outputs understandable, explainable, and actionable inside the workflows where customers already make decisions.
  • Establish reusable practices for experimentation, model documentation, validation, monitoring, and responsible claims about predictive performance.
  • Communicate findings, tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations clearly to technical partners, product leaders, and executives.
  • Share knowledge through design reviews, documentation, pairing, and mentorship across Fleet Intelligence and adjacent teams.

Your Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in applied data science, machine learning, statistical modeling, or a closely related role.
  • A track record of developing and shipping models or decision-support systems that influenced real customer or business outcomes.
  • Strong proficiency with DBT, Python, and SQL, including exploratory analysis, feature engineering, model development, and evaluation on large datasets.
  • Strong grounding in statistics and machine learning fundamentals, including model selection, validation, calibration, uncertainty, bias, and error analysis.
  • Experience with time-series forecasting, regression, classification, ranking, anomaly detection, survival or reliability analysis, or optimization; depth in several of these areas is more important than breadth across all of them.
  • Experience taking models beyond notebooks into reliable production workflows, including versioning, testing, deployment, observability, performance monitoring, and retraining or refresh strategies.
  • Experience using modern cloud data platforms and transformation workflows such as Snowflake, dbt, and orchestration tools in support of applied modeling work.
  • Ability to identify data-quality limitations, recommend improvements, and collaborate with data engineers on pipelines and source reliability.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, particularly when explaining complex methods, uncertainty, and tradeoffs to non-specialists.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Design, Software Engineering, and Data Engineering.

Considered a Plus

  • Experience with fleet, transportation, maintenance, reliability, asset management, insurance, logistics, or another operational domain.
  • Experience modeling maintenance cost, equipment failure, remaining useful life, warranty exposure, utilization, demand, or asset replacement decisions.
  • Familiarity with semantic layers and analytics tools such as ThoughtSpot or Cube.
  • Experience designing experiments or evaluating recommendations when randomized testing is impractical.
  • Experience contributing to customer-facing software products or collaborating closely with full-stack product engineers.
  • Graduate study in statistics, data science, computer science, operations research, applied mathematics, economics, or a related quantitative field.

Benefits

  • Multiple health/dental coverage options (100% coverage for employee, 50% for family)
  • Vision insurance
  • Incentive stock options
  • 401(k) match of 4%
